title: Agent Lifecycle Receipt Submit Response
description: ALR-1102 Route 4 response (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:724-736): the 201 first-write or 200 exact-replay response for POST .../agent-lifecycle/run-plans/{run_plan_ref}/receipts. This document is closed with exactly seven properties and MUST NOT contain nonce, a raw prediction/output/input/gold value, a raw artifact digest, an internal policy token, or a caller/server principal (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:736). Because this document has no nonce property at all, additionalProperties:false rejects one on sight -- this is the negative half of guard-killing mutation #5 (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:1143, corpus case receipt_response_echoes_nonce): the ONLY response that may legally carry nonce is agent_lifecycle_run_plan_issue_response_schema.json (Route 3's original issue response and its exact transport-idempotent replay). measurement_coverage uses the LiveSealedMeasurementCoverage shape defined locally below -- distinct from (not a duplicate of) the common schema's RecordMeasurementCoverage, which is reserved for Route 5's top-level field only (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:738-746, 'Coverage schema inventory and predicates'): a seal response always produces real accounting, so state is restricted to COMPLETE|PARTIAL (never UNMEASURED/UNKNOWN -- corpus case coverage_seal_response_unmeasured_or_unknown_invalid) and basis is fixed to SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE (never LATEST_SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE -- corpus case coverage_seal_response_wrong_basis). Per the 2026-08-09 owner accounting decision (runs/agent-lifecycle-contract-integration/OWNER_DECISION_ACCOUNTING_20260809.md, Option A/'P'): the two fields that decision deleted from Part 1 entirely do not appear anywhere on this response, and duplicate is schema-const 0 on every branch -- the complete accepted count set is expected/produced/cached/missing/failed/fallback/excluded/duplicate, never a ninth accounting field. rescorability is the receipt-submission aggregate: client-attested and NO-authority by construction (trust_level and authority_effect are both schema-const), matching the receipt-local ceiling (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:734).

state.description: Aggregate rule (closes Opus P1-4): available only when measurement_coverage.state=COMPLETE and every accepted receipt is individually available; unavailable when any accepted receipt is unavailable; unknown otherwise (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:734). Cross-receipt aggregation the response document alone cannot decide (the receipts array is not echoed back) -- proved by a Backend-side test (corpus cases rescorability_aggregate_available_all_receipts_available valid / rescorability_aggregate_falsely_available_with_unavailable_accepted_receipt service_invalid), not this schema.

trust_level.description: Always client_attested regardless of aggregate state (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:734); never elevated (corpus case record_client_rescorability_raises_authority).

authority_effect.description: Always NONE regardless of aggregate state (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:734).

LiveSealedMeasurementCoverage.description: Required fields are state, basis, trust_level, all eight counts, and the closed bounded-reason array; state=COMPLETE|PARTIAL, basis=SEALED_EVIDENCE_EPISODE, every count is an integer in 0..10000, expected is in 1..10000, and duplicate is schema const 0 (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:742). Mirrors the shape of the common schema's RecordMeasurementCoverage COMPLETE/PARTIAL branches but is a distinct named definition scoped to this response and Route 5's sealed evidence_episodes[] items -- never reused for Route 5's top-level field, which selects among four branches this Route 4 response can never produce (UNKNOWN legacy marker, UNMEASURED). expected=produced+cached+missing+failed+fallback+excluded is a cross-field arithmetic identity and is service_invalid (corpus case coverage_arithmetic_mismatch), not schema-decidable; the two branches below enforce only what a generic JSON Schema validator can decide from this instance alone.

missing.description: COMPLETE forces every non-produced/cached count to zero (corpus case coverage_complete_with_missing).

duplicate.description: Owner accounting decision: fixed at 0 on every accepted branch (corpus case coverage_duplicate_nonzero).

reason_codes.description: COMPLETE carries no caveat reason unless the underlying contract is client-attested (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:262, :752): assignment-free, exactly [] or [CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY].
PARTIAL always carries INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE_EPISODE, optionally alongside CLIENT_ATTESTED_ONLY when the underlying contract is client-attested (PART1_CONTRACT_FREEZE_DRAFT.md:262, :752).
